findings.text: follow-on: the same-plan section wait is kept out of dependents[target_slug] by an untested guard — reverting it to add every waiting_slug reddens no case, because every fixture in the change and in tests/test_section_edge_stays_off_plan_blocking.py wires sections across plans, so the self-unlock regression observed on power_convertor can return unremarked.

follow-on: the assertion compares result["open_paths"][0]["sections"] with result["critical_path"]["sections"], and critical_path is built at reckon/roadmap.py:3783 as a copy of open_paths[0], so the two sides are the same list object and the assertion holds whatever the code does — the node's own mutation arm confirms it, reporting this test as one of the two survivors.

follow-on: the after_suite command reads ".../python -q tests/..." with no -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider and carries no failure_count, so the field cannot be re-run or read as the arm it claims to record, so the suite-delta reader must fall back to logs/gate.log.
